segments.text:
BAptiſme ought to be geuē vnto ſuch as be taught vnto penaunce, and do beleue that theyr
ſynnes be taken awaye by Ieſus Chriſte, and wyll walke in hys reſurrection. Therefore it ought to be miniſtred vnto ſuch as aſke for it theym ſelues, and not vnto Infantes, as hitherto hathe bene vſed in the Popes kyngedome.
